text:
NEW Magic of Disney Animation | Full Walkthrough at Disney's Hollywood Studios
Step inside the brand-new The Magic of Disney Animation at Disney's Hollywood Studios and experience a complete POV tour of this exciting new destination at Walt Disney World Resort!

From the moment Disney characters welcome guests with an "Open House" invitation outside the building inspired by the legendary Disney Animation Studios in Burbank, California, you'll be immersed in the art, storytelling and magic behind Walt Disney Animation Studios.

In this full walkthrough, you'll discover:

✨ Animation artwork and exhibits that come to life
✨ Interactive Disney MagicBand+ experiences with characters like Baymax, Maximus and Kakamora
✨ A screening of Once Upon a Studio inside the Once Upon a Studio Theater
✨ Disney Animation artwork featuring favorites from The Princess and the Frog, Pocahontas and more
✨ Hidden details including Stitch in an animator's office and Mushu playing Fix-It Felix, Jr.
✨ Drawn to Wonderland, a whimsical Alice in Wonderland-themed indoor kids play area
✨ Off the Page! character greetings featuring Disney favorites
✨ Meet-and-greet locations for Rapunzel, Mulan, Stitch, Chip 'n Dale, Donald Duck, Daisy Duck and Goofy
✨ Olaf Draws!, an all-new animation experience led by everyone's favorite snowman
✨ The Gallery Wrap Party featuring artifacts and memorabilia from Disney animated films
✨ Iconic props inspired by classics including Cinderella, Moana, The Aristocats and more

Whether you're planning your next Walt Disney World vacation or simply love Disney Animation, this complete tour showcases everything you can experience inside this incredible new attraction.

Which part of Magic of Disney Animation are you most excited to experience? Let us know in the comments below!
